evidence: Loaded data/training_data.csv into workspace.mlpabd74aad.training_data via a UC volume and analyzed it with SQL on a Databricks warehouse. f4 has Pearson correlation 0.993 with the label and a Mann-Whitney AUC of exactly 1.0 — perfect separation: for label=0 f4 lies in [-0.513, 0.426], for label=1 in [2.142, 2.835], with zero overlap. All other features are near-noise (correlations 0.002-0.111, AUCs 0.50-0.56). f4 is the post-outcome leaky feature.
